name: copynotes
description: Minimal local and shared copy notes with Cloudflare sync

scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check app-config.js && node --check syntax.js && node --check links.js && node --check code-editor.js && node --check sharing.js && node --check server.cjs && node --check lib/cloud-api.mjs && node --check lib/sqlite-adapter.cjs && node --check lib/login-admin.cjs && node --check scripts/manage-logins.cjs && node --check scripts/build.cjs
scripts.cloud:dev: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.156.0 pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: gh workflow run pages.yml --ref main --repo itachi-kun-itc/CopyNotes
scripts.deploy:api: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.156.0 pages deploy dist --project-name copynotes --branch main
scripts.db:migrate: npx --yes wrangler@4.156.0 d1 migrations apply copynotes-db --remote
